headline: On November 4, 1993: China Airlines Flight 605 overruns runway
captionCards: First hull loss of a 747-400 in a stormy landing
Incident raised awareness about adverse weather safety
instagramCaption:
China Airlines Flight 605 crashes at Hong Kong Kai Tak Airport. \\[A brand-new Boeing 747-400, on a daily non-stop flight from Taipei to Hong Kong, went off the runway during a storm. This was the first hull loss of a 747-400. The incident highlighted the challenges of landing in adverse weather conditions. \\Why do you think this event is still discussed today? \\Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
